VBO:0200984.summary: Responsive to its owner and reserved with strangers, the Pampas Deerhound is the Brazilian Veadeiro Pampeano. It can track and pursue furred game beyond its handler’s sight, working alone or with other dogs; its standard calls for a calm manner within the hunting group. The breed is particularly associated with Rio Grande do Sul.
VBO:0200984.shortDescription: A Brazilian hunting dog, responsive to its owner and reserved with strangers, working alone or in a calm group.

sources.title: CBKC — Veadeiro Pampeano official standard NR07
sources.evidence: Entire5-page original PDF and extraction read. Owner-obedient, stranger-reserved, works out of handler sight, hunts alone or in groups requiring calm group behavior. Rectangular functional body, natural rose ears/alert erect, intact low short-haired tail no longer than upperhock, short dense rough coat white through lionfawn. No universal child safety, medical, origin hypothesis, actual work-trial test or FCI recognition claim.
